start: A workout in progress from a followed plan, a library exercise with no set ticked

steps.action: Tap the exercise menu, tap 'Swap exercise'
user_sees: Sheet titled 'Swap <exercise>'
Line 'For this workout only. Your routine stays.'
Up to four choices, each with a reason like 'Chest · dumbbells'
must_not: A choice that needs equipment the plan says the member does not have
A choice from the member's 'never' list or one left out for a sore area
An exercise already in this workout

steps.action: Tap one of the choices
user_sees: The card now shows the new exercise
must_not: The routine itself changed
Ticked sets moved onto the new exercise

start: Routine page of a routine in a plan, a library exercise

steps.action: Tap the swap button next to the exercise
user_sees: Sheet titled 'Swap <exercise>'
Line 'In this routine from now on. Your sets and reps stay.'
must_not: Choices that ignore the plan's equipment, sore areas or 'never' list

steps.action: Tap a choice
user_sees: The routine shows the new exercise with the same sets and reps
must_not: The old sets and reps lost
A swap that only lasts for one workout

start: Plan builder result screen after answering the questions

steps.action: Tap swap on an exercise of a built routine
user_sees: Sheet with line 'Fits your equipment and sore areas.'
must_not: A choice that does not fit the answers given

steps.action: Tap a choice
user_sees: The plan shows the new exercise; weekly sets per muscle update
must_not: The plan saved before the member keeps it

start: A workout in progress, the member's own exercise (not from the library) or nothing in the library fits

steps.action: Tap 'Swap exercise' on the member's own exercise
user_sees: The full exercise picker opens with 'Instead of <name>, for this workout only'
must_not: An empty sheet with no way forward

steps.action: For a library exercise with no close match, open the swap sheet
user_sees: 'Nothing in the library is a close match. Choose any exercise below.'
'Choose any exercise' row
must_not: A blank list with no words
A cardio move offered in place of a lift

steps.action: Pick a choice when the exercise cannot be found on the phone
user_sees: 'Could not swap' 'Please try again.'
must_not: The card left half-changed

start: A workout with two sets ticked on an exercise

steps.action: Swap the exercise after ticking sets
user_sees: The new exercise on the card
must_not: The ticked sets lost or moved onto the new exercise

steps.action: Finish the workout and start the same routine next time
user_sees: The original exercise is back in the routine
must_not: The workout-only swap kept in the routine

start: Any swap

steps.action: Open the swap sheet
user_sees: Choices worked out on the phone from its own library and the plan's answers
must_not: The sore areas or 'never' list sent anywhere off the phone to pick choices

note: Plan answers with every equipment and sore area left out can leave zero choices; long exercise names are clipped at 2 lines

why_not: no dates: choices do not depend on the day or time
note: none
Pick closes the sheet first, then looks up the exercise; a fast second tap could start a second swap
Swapped-in exercise shows weights in the chosen unit
Reason line is one line only; cut off at big font
Older plan folders may lack builder answers: falls back to full gym, no sore areas
Watch shows the current exercise of the workout; after a swap it must show the new one

start: Member follows a plan with easy weeks on, now in plan week 6

steps.action: Open the Workout tab
user_sees: Up next card with 'Easy week: half the sets, the same weights. Until <date>.'
'Train normally this week' button
must_not: The plan week line shown together with the easy-week note
No end date when the easy week was taken by tap

steps.action: Tap the easy-week line
user_sees: 'Easy week: half the sets, the same weights, and stop with 3 or more reps left. ... These workouts stay out of your records.'
must_not: The why text shown without a tap

steps.action: Start the routine and finish it
user_sees: Each exercise shows half its planned sets (at least one) at the same weights
must_not: Weights lowered
A new record pop-up for an easy-week set
The easy workout used as 'last time' for next week's target

start: Plan builder, last step 'Time per workout'

steps.action: See the 'Easy week every 6 weeks' switch
user_sees: Caption 'Half the sets, the same weights. Kept out of your records.'
The switch on by default
must_not: The switch off by default while the code default is on

steps.action: Tap 'Build my plan' and follow it
user_sees: The plan's weeks count from today; week 6 is an easy week
must_not: An easy week in week 1

start: Ready program page

steps.action: Open a program, leave the easy-week switch as it is, add and follow it
user_sees: The program folder followed with easy weeks on
must_not: Easy weeks set on a program the member switched them off for

start: Member's own folder followed, easy weeks switched off

steps.action: Open the Workout tab in plan week 6
user_sees: No easy-week note; normal sets
must_not: An easy week shown with the switch off
'Train normally this week' shown with nothing to skip

steps.action: On another plan with an easy week showing, tap 'Train normally this week' when the save fails
user_sees: 'Could not change the week' 'Please try again.'
must_not: The note gone while the week is still easy after reopening

start: Plan week 6, easy week showing

steps.action: Tap 'Train normally this week'
user_sees: The note goes; normal sets for this week
must_not: The next easy week coming sooner than 6 weeks later

steps.action: In a later week tap 'Take an easy week now' (from the stall offer)
user_sees: The easy-week note with 'Until <date seven days on>'
must_not: Fewer than seven easy days
The rhythm's next easy week inside the next 6 weeks

steps.action: Edit an easy-week workout later from history
user_sees: The workout stays marked easy; no records from it
must_not: Records made from an edited easy-week workout

start: An easy-week workout is finished

steps.action: Look at what the gym or trainer can see
user_sees: The workout counts as a workout like any other where the member shares workouts
must_not: Easy-week flag or plan settings shown to anyone the member did not share with

why_not: no list or text input: the result depends only on the week number and the switch
note: none
Plan weeks count 7-day blocks from the start day; a workout started 23:59 on the last easy day and the time zone decide which week it is
Closing mid easy workout must keep the easy flag on the resumed workout; double tap on 'Train normally' moves the base twice
Same weights shown in the chosen unit
The note line plus date must wrap
A plan from before Phase 4 has no start day: weeks start today (planState.ts:142)
Watch must show the halved set count of the easy workout

start: Member follows a plan with easy weeks every 6 weeks, logs RPE (advanced sets on), plan week 1

steps.action: Start the plan's routine
user_sees: Each exercise's Target line
must_not: An effort line for a member who does not log RPE

steps.action: Tap the i on the Target line
user_sees: 'This week of your plan, stop each set with about 3 reps left in the tank (RPE 7).'
must_not: A different number of reps left than the RPE shown (RPE must be 10 minus reps left)

steps.action: Train on to plan week 5 and open the i again
user_sees: '... about 1 rep left in the tank (RPE 9).'
must_not: Effort going down instead of climbing through the block

start: Followed plan, 3 lifts in the plan stalled (reps fell under range twice, or flat for 4 workouts), at least 2 normal weeks since the start or the last easy week

steps.action: Open the Workout tab
user_sees: Inside Up next: '3 lifts stuck at the same numbers. An easy week now often gets them moving again.'
'Take an easy week now' button
must_not: The offer shown together with an easy-week note or a muscle tip (only one extra line)

steps.action: Tap 'Take an easy week now'
user_sees: 'Easy week: half the sets, the same weights. Until <date>.'
must_not: The offer still shown after the tap

start: Only 2 lifts stalled, or 3 stalled one week after an easy week, or a plan not followed

steps.action: Open the Workout tab
user_sees: No early easy-week offer; the normal Up next card
must_not: The offer shown for fewer than 3 stalled lifts
The offer right after an easy week
The offer for a folder the member does not follow

start: Easy week with RPE logging on

steps.action: Start a routine during the easy week
user_sees: The easy-week reason behind the i ('stop with 3 or more reps left')
must_not: A climbing effort line in the easy week

steps.action: Tap 'Train normally this week'
user_sees: The effort line comes back as the block's last, hardest week (about 1 rep left)
must_not: No effort line after skipping

start: Any effort line

steps.action: Look at the effort line
user_sees: Worked out on the phone from the plan's week
must_not: RPE or stall counts shared with anyone the member did not choose

note: A plan routine with no logged history: no stall count, effort line still right
Plan week from the start day decides the reps-left number
'Take an easy week now' has no busy state
No template fits the RPE switch: the effort line only shows with the advanced sets setting on (coachTargets.ts:418), turning it off must hide it; language must translate the effort sentence
Offer sentence and button inside the Up next card
Plan with no start day: weeks start today

why_not: the effort line and offer only show on the phone's Workout tab and Target line
note: none

start: Workout tab, member has not added any program

steps.action: Open 'Find a plan'
user_sees: Title 'Find a plan', subtitle 'A plan built for you, or a ready program.'
Groups for gym, dumbbells only and home, each beginner to advanced, with lines like 'Beginner · 3 days a week'
must_not: A group with no programs
'1 days a week'

steps.action: Tap a program
user_sees: Program page with its summary, the 'Easy week every 6 weeks' switch and 'Follow this plan' / 'Add to my routines'
'<n> routines · <n> days a week' with each routine's exercises as '3 × 8–12'
must_not: An exercise the library does not know shown as a blank row

steps.action: Tap 'Follow this plan'
user_sees: Back on the Workout tab with the program's folder open and followed
must_not: Two folders made by one tap
The program added but not followed

start: Program page

steps.action: Tap 'Add to my routines'
user_sees: Back on the Workout tab with the folder open, not followed
must_not: The member's current plan changed

start: Program page opened from an old or wrong link

steps.action: Open a program key that does not exist
user_sees: 'Program not found' 'Go back and pick another.'
must_not: A crash or blank page

steps.action: Tap 'Follow this plan' when the save fails
user_sees: 'Could not add the program' 'Please try again.'
must_not: A half-made folder left on the Workout tab

start: A program already added

steps.action: Open the same program again
user_sees: 'Already in your routines ("<name>").' with 'Follow it' and 'Add a copy'; or 'You follow this program ("<name>").'
must_not: 'Follow this plan' offered again, making a second folder

steps.action: Tap 'Follow it'
user_sees: The existing folder is followed
must_not: A second folder
The member's own edits in that folder lost without a word

steps.action: Tap 'Add a copy'
user_sees: A second folder of the program, not followed
must_not: The first folder changed

start: Any program

steps.action: Add a program
user_sees: The folder lives on the phone and in the member's cloud copy
must_not: The program choice shown to the gym or other members

note: Long exercise names wrap at 2 lines next to '3 × 8–12'

why_not: the library does not change with the date; easy-week dates are F-phone-926
note: none
busy ref guards the add; closing mid-add must not leave a half folder
Sets x reps only, no weights; distance work shows '2 sets'
Routine header row has name, badge and count on one line
A program folder added by an older version must still be found as 'Already in your routines'

why_not: program pages are phone only; the watch only sees the started workout
note: none
